prompt:
Users want to duplicate an episode, to try another take without losing the original.
- Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/duplicate`, returning the new episode. The copy goes after the project's other episodes, its title marks it as a copy, and it keeps the summary and the same cuts in the same order, with their scripts, dialogues, layouts, characters and images. Changing or deleting either episode afterwards never affects the other. Duplicating is free. Only members of the episode's workspace may duplicate it; to anyone else the episode does not exist (404).
- On the project's Episodes page, every episode gets a Duplicate action next to Delete, and the copy shows up in the list without a reload. Both languages.
Add tests.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.
follow_ups:
Change of plan for the order: a copy goes right after its original, and the episodes after it move down one place. Deleting an episode closes the gap. A project's episodes are always numbered 1, 2, 3… with no gaps or repeats, and the list API returns them in that order.
Keep the tests up to date.

Users delete episodes by mistake. Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/restore`: a deleted episode comes back with its cuts at the place it had, and the episodes from there on move down one place. Only members of its workspace may restore it; to anyone else it does not exist (404).
On the Episodes page, the message shown after a delete offers Undo, which restores the episode. Both languages. Add tests.

report.answer: Added `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/restore` to restore a deleted episode and its cuts at its previous position for workspace members, added an Undo action to the delete toast on the project's Episodes page in both English and Korean, and added backend tests.

+def _renumber_project_episodes(session: Session, project_id: UUID) -> List[Episode]:
+    """Ensure active episodes for a project are numbered 1, 2, 3... with no gaps or repeats."""
+    statement = (
+        select(Episode)
+        .where(Episode.project_id == project_id)
+        .where(Episode.deleted_at == None)
+        .order_by(Episode.episode_order, Episode.created_at)
+    )
+    episodes = list(session.exec(statement).all())
+    changed = False
+    for idx, ep in enumerate(episodes, start=1):

+            session.add(ep)

+from uuid import uuid4
+
+from sqlmodel import Session
+
+from app.db.engine import engine
+from app.models import Workspace, WorkspaceMember
+from tests.conftest import signup
+

+def _create_project(client, headers, title="Night Bus"):
+    r = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=headers, json={"title": title, "genres": []})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()
+
+
+def _create_episode(client, headers, project_id, title="Episode 1", order=1, summary="First ride"):
+    r = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/episodes",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={
+            "title": title,
+            "project_id": project_id,
+            "episode_order": order,
+            "story_summary": summary,
+        },
+    )
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()
+
+
+def _create_cut(
+    client,
+    headers,
+    episode_id,
+    cut_order,
+    script,
+    selected_layout="wide",
+    aspect_ratio="16:9",
+    dialogues=None,
+    appearing_characters=None,
+    image_path=None,
+):
+    r = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/cuts",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={
+            "episode_id": episode_id,
+            "cut_order": cut_order,
+            "script": script,
+            "selected_layout": selected_layout,
+            "aspect_ratio": aspect_ratio,
+            "dialogues": dialogues or [],
+            "appearing_characters": appearing_characters or [],
+            "image_path": image_path,
+        },
+    )
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()
+
+
+def test_duplicate_episode_inserts_right_after_original_and_shifts_following_episodes(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    project = _create_project(client, h)
+    ep1 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Prologue", order=1, summary="A dark rainy night")
+    ep2 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Chapter 2", order=2, summary="Next morning")
+    ep3 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Chapter 3", order=3, summary="Noon")
+
+    cut2 = _create_cut(
+        client,
+        h,
+        ep1["id"],
+        cut_order=2,
+        script="Bus doors open.",
+        selected_layout="vertical",
+        aspect_ratio="9:16",
+        dialogues=[{"speaker": "Driver", "text": "Hop in."}],
+        appearing_characters=[{"id": "c2", "name": "Driver"}],
+        image_path="https://example.com/cut2.png",
+    )
+    cut1 = _create_cut(
+        client,
+        h,
+        ep1["id"],
+        cut_order=1,
+        script="Hero waits at the stop.",
+        selected_layout="wide",
+        aspect_ratio="16:9",
+        dialogues=[{"speaker": "Hero", "text": "Late again."}],
+        appearing_characters=[{"id": "c1", "name": "Hero"}],
+        image_path="https://example.com/cut1.png",
+    )
+
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep1['id']}/duplicate", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    copy_ep = r.json()
+
+    assert copy_ep["id"] != ep1["id"]
+    assert copy_ep["project_id"] == project["id"]
+    assert ep1["title"] in copy_ep["title"]
+    assert "copy" in copy_ep["title"].lower()
+    assert copy_ep["story_summary"] == "A dark rainy night"
+    assert copy_ep["episode_order"] == 2
+    assert copy_ep["first_cut_image"] == "https://example.com/cut1.png"
+
+    episodes = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [e["id"] for e in episodes] == [ep1["id"], copy_ep["id"], ep2["id"], ep3["id"]]
+    assert [e["episode_order"] for e in episodes] == [1, 2, 3, 4]
+
+    copied_cuts = client.get(f"/api/v1/cuts?episode_id={copy_ep['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert len(copied_cuts) == 2
+    assert copied_cuts[0]["id"] != cut1["id"]
+    assert copied_cuts[1]["id"] != cut2["id"]
+    assert [c["cut_order"] for c in copied_cuts] == [1, 2]
+    assert [c["script"] for c in copied_cuts] == ["Hero waits at the stop.", "Bus doors open."]
+    assert [c["selected_layout"] for c in copied_cuts] == ["wide", "vertical"]
+    assert [c["aspect_ratio"] for c in copied_cuts] == ["16:9", "9:16"]
+    assert [c["dialogues"] for c in copied_cuts] == [
+        [{"speaker": "Hero", "text": "Late again."}],
+        [{"speaker": "Driver", "text": "Hop in."}],
+    ]
+    assert [c["appearing_characters"] for c in copied_cuts] == [
+        [{"id": "c1", "name": "Hero"}],
+        [{"id": "c2", "name": "Driver"}],
+    ]
+    assert [c["image_path"] for c in copied_cuts] == [
+        "https://example.com/cut1.png",
+        "https://example.com/cut2.png",
+    ]
+
+
+def test_deleting_episode_closes_the_gap_and_keeps_1_to_n_numbering(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    project = _create_project(client, h)
+    ep1 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Ep 1", order=1)
+    ep2 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Ep 2", order=2)
+    ep3 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Ep 3", order=3)
+
+    # Duplicate Ep 1 -> [ep1(1), copy1(2), ep2(3), ep3(4)]
+    copy1 = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep1['id']}/duplicate", headers=h).json()
+    episodes = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [e["id"] for e in episodes] == [ep1["id"], copy1["id"], ep2["id"], ep3["id"]]
+    assert [e["episode_order"] for e in episodes] == [1, 2, 3, 4]
+
+    # Delete copy1 (order 2) -> closes gap: [ep1(1), ep2(2), ep3(3)]
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{copy1['id']}", headers=h).status_code == 204
+    episodes = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [e["id"] for e in episodes] == [ep1["id"], ep2["id"], ep3["id"]]
+    assert [e["episode_order"] for e in episodes] == [1, 2, 3]
+
+    # Delete ep1 (order 1) -> closes gap: [ep2(1), ep3(2)]
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep1['id']}", headers=h).status_code == 204
+    episodes = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [e["id"] for e in episodes] == [ep2["id"], ep3["id"]]
+    assert [e["episode_order"] for e in episodes] == [1, 2]
+    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep2['id']}", headers=h).json()["episode_order"] == 1
+    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep3['id']}", headers=h).json()["episode_order"] == 2
+
+    # Create a new episode after deletions -> goes to 3 with no gap or repeat
+    ep4 = _create_episode(client, h, project["id"], title="Ep 4", order=99)
+    assert ep4["episode_order"] == 3
+    episodes = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={project['id']}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [e["id"] for e in episodes] == [ep2["id"], ep3["id"], ep4["id"]]
+    assert [e["episode_order"] for e in episodes] == [1, 2, 3]
+
